scope: infrastructure validation and forced-proposal calibration; not an independent holdout or competition ASR
approval_rule: A sealed-range test principal approves every policy ASK through the same bound approve/commit path. It does not consult attack labels, variant names or expected utility, and is not a human approval study.
pairing: same paired task ID, document/workspace bytes, logical goals/grants/budgets, fixed Git author/committer epoch, model recipe and initial model messages/tools; physical layouts/ports, event/artifact IDs and wall-clock timestamps are independent instance bindings
ordering: rotate variant order by pair index, execute sequentially in fresh owned ranges; preserve failed and unexecuted cells
